description: Follow or unfollow a reader. A procedure, not a query: it writes the caller's follow edge, so it must never be cached, prefetched or replayed as an idempotent read.

main.description: The viewer is identified by a service JWT (lxm net.olamaelcu.livtet.biblio.graph.follow, aud did:web:biblio.livtet.olamaelcu.net#atproto_feed) or by the storefront session cookie. A request header is not accepted as identity.

followed.description: DID of the reader being followed or unfollowed.
